home.title: Everyday Apparel
home.body: Discover cotton tees, Oxford shirts and easy trousers in the everyday collection.

blocks.heading: Clothes for the everyday

shop.title: Shop all clothing
shop.body: Browse tops and trousers by category and find the fabric and fit that suit you.

blocks.imageAlt: Cotton tops and linen trousers on a clothing rail

items.title: Which size am I ordering?
items.body: The size and fit are listed with each garment. Check those details before choosing a quantity.

items.title: How should I care for my garment?
items.body: Open the product details for its fabric and care instructions and follow the sewn-in care label.

blocks.heading: Inside the workroom
blocks.body: Take a closer look at the fabrics in our collection.
blocks.imageAlt: Checking the cuff of a shirt beside fabric swatches in the workroom

cart.title: Your cart
cart.body: Review your styles, quantities and delivery total before checkout.

blocks.imageAlt: Folded clothing being wrapped in tissue for delivery

items.title: When is stock reserved?
items.body: We check availability when you place the order. Adding an item to your cart does not reserve it.

items.title: Can I order as a guest?
items.body: Yes. Continue to checkout and enter your delivery details.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.body: Enter your contact and delivery details to order your clothing.

blocks.imageAlt: Folded clothing being wrapped in tissue for delivery

order-success.title: Thank you for your order
order-success.body: Your clothing order has been received.

blocks.imageAlt: Folded clothing being wrapped in tissue for delivery

blocks.heading: Keep your order number
blocks.body: Use the number on your receipt when asking about this order.

login.title: Sign in
login.body: Sign in to see your clothing orders and their status.

blocks.imageAlt: Cotton tops and linen trousers on a clothing rail

register.title: Create an account
register.body: Keep your orders together and check their status from your account.

blocks.imageAlt: Ivory cotton crew tee worn with navy straight-leg chinos

account.title: Your account
account.body: View your profile and follow your clothing orders.

blocks.imageAlt: Cotton tops and linen trousers on a clothing rail

about.title: About the collection
about.body: Our everyday collection pairs cotton jersey and Oxford cloth with twill and linen. Discover the cut, fabric and care details on each product page.

blocks.imageAlt: Checking the cuff of a shirt beside fabric swatches in the workroom

shipping.title: Delivery and returns
shipping.body: Review your delivery charge in the cart. Keep your order number handy for delivery or return enquiries.

blocks.imageAlt: Folded clothing being wrapped in tissue for delivery

items.title: Where can I see the delivery fee?
items.body: Your cart and checkout show the charge for your order.

items.title: When do I pay?
items.body: Pay the total shown on your receipt when your order is delivered.

contact.title: Order help
contact.body: Have your order number and the name of the garment ready when asking about an order.

blocks.imageAlt: Checking the cuff of a shirt beside fabric swatches in the workroom

items.title: Where is my order number?
items.body: Your confirmation screen shows the number after checkout. For an order placed while signed in, you can also find it in your account.

items.title: Where can I check the status?
items.body: Open your account to see the latest status of orders placed with that account.
